blurb: Guests join guided marine excursions to observe wildlife such as whales, bears, sea lions, and eagles. Tours include visits to Hot Springs Cove with a 2 km boardwalk hike, sea kayaking trips with interpretive programs, and rainforest walks on Meares Island. Programs emphasize ecological education and connection between forest and ocean ecosystems.
